cases.translation: Every wise woman builds her house.
cases.explain: Женщина is the grammatical subject of the verb устроит (builds).

cases.translation: He who walks in his uprightness fears Yahweh.
cases.explain: The verb боится (fears) governs the genitive case.

cases.sentence: Мудрость разумных — свой путь понимать, а коварство — это глупость ___.
cases.translation: The wisdom of the prudent is to think about his way, but the folly of fools is deceit.
cases.explain: The genitive shows possession: глупость глупцов (the folly of fools).

cases.sentence: Дом нечестивых будет разрушен, а шатер праведных будет ___.
cases.translation: The house of the wicked will be overthrown, but the tent of the upright will flourish.
cases.explain: The predicate after будет requires the instrumental case.

cases.translation: The poor person is shunned even by his own neighbor.
cases.explain: Соседи is the grammatical subject of the understood verb (they/neighbors).

cases.translation: The wicked is brought down in his calamity.
cases.explain: Злодейство is the direct object of the implied verb (губит = destroys).

cases.sentence: Идущий прямым путем боится ___, а тот, чьи пути кривы, его презирает.
cases.translation: He who walks in his uprightness fears Yahweh, but he who is perverse in his ways despises him.
cases.explain: The verb боится (fears) governs the genitive case.

cases.sentence: Праведность возносит ___, а грех позор для него.
cases.translation: Righteousness exalts a nation, but sin is a disgrace to any people.
cases.explain: Народ as the direct object of возносит (exalts) takes the accusative case.

reading.ru: Мудрая женщина дом свой устроит, а глупая своими руками разрушит.
reading.question: What is the contrast between a wise woman and a foolish one?
options: The wise builds her house while the foolish destroys it
Both are equally successful in managing their homes
The foolish woman builds while the wise one destroys
Neither has any effect on their household
reading.correct: The wise builds her house while the foolish destroys it
reading.explain: The verse contrasts: мудрая женщина дом устроит (the wise woman builds her house) with глупая разрушит (the foolish one destroys it).

reading.ru: Дом нечестивых будет разрушен, а шатер праведных будет процветать.
reading.question: What will happen to the houses of the wicked versus the righteous?
options: The wicked's house will be overthrown while the righteous's tent will flourish
The righteous will be destroyed while the wicked will flourish
reading.correct: The wicked's house will be overthrown while the righteous's tent will flourish
reading.explain: Дом нечестивых будет разрушен (the house of the wicked will be destroyed) contrasts with шатер праведных будет процветать (the tent of the righteous will flourish).

reading.ru: Бедных не любят даже их соседи, а у богатых много друзей.
reading.question: How do neighbors and friends treat the poor versus the rich?
options: Even neighbors shun the poor while the rich have many friends
The poor are welcomed while the rich are avoided
All people are treated equally regardless of wealth
The poor always have many loyal friends
reading.correct: Even neighbors shun the poor while the rich have many friends
reading.explain: The verse shows: Бедных не любят даже их соседи (the poor are shunned even by their neighbors) versus у богатых много друзей (the rich have many friends).

reading.ru: Кто боится Господа, тот в неприступной крепости, и детям его будет прибежище.
reading.question: What protection does fear of the Lord provide?
options: A secure fortress for him and a refuge for his children
reading.correct: A secure fortress for him and a refuge for his children
reading.explain: The text states: в неприступной крепости (in a secure fortress) and детям его будет прибежище (his children will have a refuge).

reading.ru: Мудрость покоится в сердце разумных и среди глупцов дает знать о себе.
reading.question: Where does wisdom dwell and how does it manifest?
options: In the hearts of the wise and makes itself known among fools
Only in the minds of the foolish
Wisdom is equally distributed to all
reading.correct: In the hearts of the wise and makes itself known among fools
reading.explain: The verse indicates: Мудрость покоится в сердце разумных (wisdom rests in the heart of the wise) and среди глупцов дает знать о себе (is made known among fools).

reading.ru: Праведность возносит народ, а грех позор для него.
reading.question: What is the effect of righteousness versus sin on a nation?
options: Righteousness lifts a nation while sin brings it shame
reading.correct: Righteousness lifts a nation while sin brings it shame
reading.explain: The text states: Праведность возносит народ (Righteousness exalts a nation) but грех позор для него (sin is disgrace to it).
